system.protected: This is the platform's operating organization; it cannot be suspended, deleted or re-planned.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: Every organization on the platform with its plan and usage.

create.title: Create organization
create.trialHint: If left empty, the plan's default applies.
create.passwordHint: A one-time password is generated for a new account and shown only once.
create.pendingInvitation: {{email}} already belongs to an account: the administrator invitation is waiting for the account owner to accept.

subscription.title: Plan and trial
subscription.trialHint: Valid through this day. Empty = no trial.
subscription.overridesHint: An override replaces the plan value. Fields set to "Plan value" follow the plan.
subscription.overLimitTitle: Usage is above the new limit
subscription.overLimitHint: The plan changed; nothing was deleted. New records cannot be added until the excess is resolved.

suspend.title: Suspend organization
suspend.intro: {{name}} will be suspended. The reason is written to the platform audit.
suspend.readOnlyHint: Users can see records but cannot change them.
suspend.blockedHint: No user can access the organization.

reactivate.title: Reactivate organization
reactivate.message: Reactivate {{name}}? If the trial has ended the status stays "Trial ended"; fix the plan separately.

deletion.title: Deletion request
deletion.warning: This starts a PERMANENT DESTRUCTION: after the retention period ({{days}} days) all of the organization's data is erased irreversibly. All users lose access immediately. It can be cancelled during the retention period.
deletion.retentionInvalid: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}
deletion.confirmLabel: Type the organization name to confirm: {{name}}
deletion.cancelMessage: Cancel the deletion request for {{name}} and return the organization to its previous state?
deletion.erased: This organization's data was permanently erased.
deletion.retryMessage: The failed erasure of {{name}} will be retried. Enter your own password to continue.

usage.empty: No usage snapshots in this range.

plans.title: Plans
plans.configHint: Plans are managed through configuration and cannot be changed from this screen.

reasonHint: Do not put personal data (names, e-mail addresses, phone numbers) in the reason; it is kept in the audit log.

stepUp.label: Your password
stepUp.description: This destructive action requires the signed-in platform administrator's own password.

admins.title: Platform administrators
admins.description: Accounts with access to the platform console.
admins.revokeMessage: {{name}} will no longer be able to use the platform console. Enter your own password to continue.
admins.deactivateHint: If checked, the account is deactivated entirely, not just stripped of platform access.

export.title: Export usage
export.intro: The daily usage snapshots are downloaded as CSV (for finance).
export.hint: If both dates are empty the previous calendar month is downloaded. The range can be at most 400 days (UTC days, inclusive).

errors.incomplete: Enter both dates or leave both empty.
errors.reversed: The end day cannot be before the start day.
errors.tooLong: The range can be at most 400 days.

platform.invalid_transition: This action is not possible in the current state ({{from}} → {{to}})
platform.deletion_not_cancellable: The deletion request can no longer be cancelled
platform.system_tenant_protected: This action is not allowed for the system organization
platform.step_up_required: Your own password is required for this action
platform.step_up_rate_limited: Too many incorrect password attempts; please try again later
platform.confirmation_mismatch: The typed organization name does not match
platform.last_platform_admin: The last active platform administrator cannot be revoked
platform.deletion_not_retryable: A deletion request can only be retried while it is in the failed state
